meta.title: FightBase — Coaching tool for combat sports
meta.description: Manage classes, attendance and training camps from your phone. Built for boxing, MMA and martial arts coaches.

hero.sub: FightBase is the coaching tool for boxing, MMA and martial arts coaches. Manage your members, track attendance, send announcements and run training camps — from your phone.

problem.title: Your club runs on group chats and notebooks.
problem.p1: Attendance lives in a notebook. Announcements get lost in a WhatsApp group. Camp sign-ups are scattered across DMs and a spreadsheet nobody else can open.
problem.p2: It works — until the group grows, a session moves, or you need to know who actually showed up.
problem.p3: FightBase puts it all in one place.
problem.before1: Paper list at the door → photo of the page → retype it into a spreadsheet at night
problem.after1: Open the session → tap who's here → attendance saved
problem.before2: Session moves → message three group chats → answer the same question ten times
problem.after2: Post one announcement → every member of the group sees it in the app

features.title: Everything you need to run your group.
features.sub: Built around how combat sports coaches actually work — classes, sparring sessions and camps.
features.f1Body: Keep one roster for each group. Mark attendance in seconds and see each member's training history.
features.f2Body: Send schedule changes and news to the members of a group — no more chasing replies across chats.
features.f3Body: Create a camp, add the dates and details, and see every registration in one list.

how.title: Set up in three steps.
how.s1Body: Create your coach account and add your club.
how.s2Body: Set up your classes and training camps with their schedule.
how.s3Body: Athletes register in the app and request to join. You accept them, and they're on your roster.
